description: Analyze production_payment_service.log containing 8000+ lines of mixed-severity logs. Create a file named 'triage_summary.md' in the same directory with: (1) counts of each error type (e.g., 'ERR_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT: 23 occurrences'), (2) list of at least 10 affected transaction IDs in format txn_XXXXXXXXXXXX, (3) at least 3 different error types mentioned, (4) timestamp or time range of incident, (5) structured sections with headers. All transaction IDs and error counts must be accurate based on the source log file.
